quotes.text_en: Eternal life — that is my dao!
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan
quotes.note: Widely used fan-translation rendering of his core motivation; exact chapter wording varies by translation. Chinese wording NOT verified in current corpus.

quotes.text_en: The righteous path and the demonic path are just names. Names are tools, and tools exist to be used.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan
quotes.note: Fandom paraphrase of a recurring theme. Scene identified; Chinese wording NOT verified.

quotes.text_en: I have lived five hundred years. What I lack is not courage, but certainty.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan
quotes.note: Paraphrase; do not cite as verbatim.

quotes.text_en: Retreat today is the seed of tomorrow's victory. Only the dead have lost.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan

quotes.text_en: The world owes me nothing. I owe the world nothing. We are even.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan

quotes.text_en: Allies are like Gu: useful, fed, and always able to bite your hand.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan
quotes.note: Theme paraphrase; no verbatim source located in current corpus.

quotes.text_en: If the price is acceptable, why hesitate? Hesitation is also a price.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan

quotes.text_en: A genius who cannot survive is just a corpse with talent.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan
quotes.scene: reflections on Fang Zheng and A-grade talents

quotes.text_en: Heaven's will? I will carve my own path through it.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan

quotes.text_en: The Liquor Worm looks like trash until it has drunk your future for you.
quotes.speaker: analyst (style example)
quotes.scene: NOT a canon quote — compositor style example for the formatter
quotes.note: STYLE EXAMPLE ONLY. Must never be emitted as a canon quote.

quotes.text_en: The price is acceptable. I will take it.
quotes.speaker: analyst (style example)
quotes.scene: NOT a canon quote — outer-speech style example from the policy spec
quotes.note: STYLE EXAMPLE ONLY from the policy notes.

quotes.text_en: Strength is the only truth under heaven; everything else is negotiation.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)
quotes.note: Common fandom paraphrase; no verified source.

quotes.text_en: Scheming against the wise requires honesty, for the wise verify. Scheming against fools requires only patience.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)

quotes.text_en: A blessing carried too far becomes a curse; a curse endured becomes a blade.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)
quotes.note: Theme paraphrase; echoes Daodejing ch. 58 motif.

quotes.text_en: I do not hate my enemies. Hatred is a tax the weak pay twice.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)

quotes.text_en: Every person has a price; those who claim otherwise have simply never been quoted correctly.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)

quotes.text_en: The truly dangerous man smiles, bows, and remembers.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)

quotes.text_en: Do not envy the eagle its flight; envy the patient spider its web.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)
quotes.note: Fandom-made aphorism tied to the spider trade arc; NOT verified as novel text.

quotes.text_en: When the flood comes, sell boats. When the drought comes, buy them.
quotes.speaker: Fang Yuan (attributed)
quotes.scene: trade reflections (echo of Shiji: 計然)
quotes.note: This is the Shiji Huozhi Liezhuan / Ji Ran principle (旱則資舟，水則資車) echoed in fan discussions; the novel echoes the classical trade logic. Do not cite as verbatim novel text.
